battery.notes: Place cells horizontally and centrally in the lowest safe volume. Use a protected pack/BMS and a mechanically retained cell cradle; no loose cells.

linux_compute_module_bay.notes: Use external RF antenna or preserve antenna keepout if the on-module antenna is used.

realtime_mcu.implementation: module soldered onto the custom carrier; do not reserve a DevKit board in product CAD

leg_architecture.architecture: independent compact four-bar modules, one geared actuator per leg
leg_architecture.reference_motor: 6V N20-class geared DC motor with encoder
leg_architecture.hard_rule: motor, upper linkage, chassis plate and bearings must remain inside the cosmetic body silhouette in all validated poses; only the styled foot and a short concealed neck may exit the shell

internal_structure.preferred_material: 5052/6061 aluminium prototype plate or glass-filled polymer production frame
internal_structure.bearing_rule: Do not carry robot radial/impact load directly through a motor gearbox output shaft; use a supported pivot/bearing where the linkage load path demands it.

power_architecture.thermal_rule: compute and regulator heat paths must not dump directly into the battery cradle

cad_gates.gate_1: outer silhouette matches concept orthographic targets
cad_gates.gate_3: leg swept volumes have >=2mm shell clearance
cad_gates.gate_4: zero hard-part collisions across validation pose set
cad_gates.gate_5: battery remains below target CoG plane and serviceable
cad_gates.gate_6: visor/display/camera fit without flattening the body into a sphere
cad_gates.gate_7: shell can close with realistic bosses, fasteners and cable routes
